# HEAVY HIT v4 changes

## Pistol

- raised low and low-mid noise contribution;
- reduced high-noise contribution and upper EQ bands;
- lengthened low/mid decay, sustain and release;
- widened feed-forward chorus;
- replaced the dry short FIR pattern with a denser 13-118 ms pattern;
- restored output gain after headroom validation.

## Metralla

- increased low oscillator weight and reduced high oscillator weight;
- lengthened low and mid envelopes while keeping the high crack at 5/0/9 ms;
- shifted EQ emphasis toward 35-1000 Hz;
- increased bounded chorus and FIR tail;
- retained the 83 ms demonstration burst interval.

## Gatling

- increased low oscillator weight and reduced the upper edge;
- extended the low layer to 72/5/95 ms and the mid layer to 30/2/45 ms;
- shifted EQ emphasis toward low and low-mid bands;
- increased feed-forward spatial tail;
- retained the exact 20 ms demonstration retrigger interval.
